articles.title: Southern Company receives historic Department of Energy $26.5 billion loan guarantees to increase grid reliability

articles.summary: Southern Company today reported fourth-quarter earnings of $416 million, or $0.38 per share, in 2025 compared with earnings of $534 million, or $0.49 per share, in the fourth quarter of 2024.
articles.title: Southern Company reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 earnings
